name: Offshore Tax Evasion and Undeclared Accounts
description: Concealment of income and assets from tax authorities through foreign accounts, opaque entities, nominee arrangements and cash or asset movements that avoid automatic information exchange. Financial institutions see inconsistent tax residency claims, structures with no clear purpose and attempts to evade reporting regimes.

sources.text: FATF/OECD, Money Laundering Awareness Handbook for Tax Examiners and Tax Auditors (2012)
OECD, Standard for Automatic Exchange of Financial Account Information in Tax Matters (2014; 2nd ed. 2017)
OECD, Model Mandatory Disclosure Rules for CRS Avoidance Arrangements and Opaque Offshore Structures (2018)
FATF and OECD, Money Laundering Awareness Handbook for Tax Examiners and Tax Auditors (2012)

indicators.name: Inconsistent tax residency declarations
indicators.desc: Customer self-certifies residence in one jurisdiction while mailing address, phone, spending or travel point to another.
indicators.ctx: Customer self-certifies residence in one jurisdiction while mailing address, phone, spending or travel point to another.
indicators.fp: Expatriates and frequent travellers may have complex but genuine residency.

indicators.name: Request to hold mail or avoid statements and reporting
indicators.canon: Request to hold mail or avoid statements and reporting
indicators.desc: Customer asks for hold-mail, numbered accounts or avoids providing tax identification numbers.
indicators.ctx: Customer asks for hold-mail, numbered accounts or avoids providing tax identification numbers.
indicators.fp: Privacy or security concerns can motivate such requests.

indicators.name: Funds repatriated via cash, bearer instruments or third-party accounts
indicators.canon: Funds repatriated via cash, bearer instruments or third-party accounts
indicators.desc: Customer deposits foreign-sourced cash or cheques or receives funds from unrelated individuals, avoiding visible foreign accounts.
indicators.ctx: Customer deposits foreign-sourced cash or cheques or receives funds from unrelated individuals, avoiding visible foreign accounts.
indicators.fp: Gifts and family support can cause third-party transfers.

indicators.name: Shell company or foundation with no commercial purpose holding personal assets
indicators.canon: Passive offshore vehicle or foundation holding personal assets
indicators.desc: A foundation, shell or similar vehicle in a low-transparency jurisdiction holds an individual's investments, property or accounts without commercial purpose.
indicators.ctx: Passive entity in a low-transparency jurisdiction holds the customer's investments, property or accounts.
indicators.fp: Entities can serve estate planning or asset protection legitimately.

indicators.name: Nominee directors or shareholders
indicators.desc: Registered directors or shareholders appear to act for undisclosed principals, serve many entities or have no real decision-making role.
indicators.ctx: Entity officers appear to be professional nominees with no real decision-making role.
indicators.fp: Nominees are lawful in some jurisdictions for privacy.

indicators.name: Transfers to jurisdictions with weak transparency soon after reporting changes
indicators.canon: Transfers to jurisdictions with weak transparency soon after reporting changes
indicators.desc: Funds shifted to non-participating or low-transparency jurisdictions around the introduction of reporting obligations or voluntary-disclosure windows.
indicators.ctx: Funds shifted to non-participating or low-transparency jurisdictions around the introduction of reporting obligations or voluntary-disclosure windows.
indicators.fp: Business or investment reasons may exist for moves.

indicators.name: Loans or credit cards used to access hidden funds
indicators.canon: Loans or credit cards used to access hidden funds
indicators.desc: Customer borrows locally but repays from or secured on foreign undeclared accounts, or uses offshore-issued cards for domestic spend.
indicators.ctx: Customer borrows locally but repays from or secured on foreign undeclared accounts, or uses offshore-issued cards for domestic spend.
indicators.fp: Foreign-currency collateral lending is common in private banking.

indicators.name: Use of intermediaries who market secrecy
indicators.canon: Use of intermediaries who market secrecy
indicators.desc: Customer introduced by advisers or promoters advertising confidentiality or tax-free outcomes.
indicators.ctx: Customer introduced by advisers or promoters advertising confidentiality or tax-free outcomes.
indicators.fp: Wealth advisers legitimately offer privacy and tax planning within the law.
